# About this site

This space began as a personal notebook for mathematical ideas and has grown into a small course-oriented publishing platform.

The goal is to make mathematics feel more approachable by combining:

- structured lesson sequences,
- short blog-style reflections, and
- well-organised notes that can grow over time.

This site is built using [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and deployed with [GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages).
